title: The Blow Not Thrown

mood.label: Uneasy restraint
mood.summary: Danger concentrated in one corridor — the Red Sea mouth, a shut Saudi pipeline, missiles off Wonsan, the hottest August ever measured — yet the day's best news was restraint: Riyadh declined to retaliate, and markets steadied. Tense, held, unresolved.

lines: They took the coast at the narrow mouth,
Perim in the dark where the tankers turn.
A drone found the pumps on the desert line —
Riyadh counted ten and did not burn.
Wonsan sent its rockets to the sea,
August came back the hottest ever known.
In Nairobi a hand learns how to sign,
the market lifts its head off the stone.
Hold it — don't answer, don't answer yet.
The day stands still on a taken breath.
Some days the good news is the blow not thrown,
the match not struck, the thunder withheld.
